name: io.github.mhidalgo-lab/agility-bridge
title: agility-bridge
description: Unofficial MCP server for Digital.ai Agility: read every asset type with your own access token.

environmentVariables.name: AB_AGILITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Agility instance URL, e.g. https://www7.v1host.com/YourInstance. Without it the server only lists its tools.

environmentVariables.name: AB_AGILITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Agility access token (Applications page). It acts fully as you; revoke it when no longer needed.

environmentVariables.name: AB_PROJECTS
environmentVariables.description: Allowed Agility projects as OID tokens, comma-separated (Scope:1234). Every visible project when unset.

environmentVariables.name: AB_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Tool allowlist, comma-separated tool names. Every read tool when unset.
